name: Winctl2Rust Windows Control & Automation Console
description: 100% pure-Rust non-hooking Windows command launcher, CoreAudio volume/rule controller, DDC/CI & EDID display manager, desktop/clipboard/font/webcam inspector, CLI, dual Win32/Iced GUIs, and policy-gated MCP server.
majorCapabilities: Non-hooking command script runner, launch profiles, parent-attributed spawning & Task Scheduler v2
CoreAudio endpoint/session control, CLI verbs, PropertyStore per-app routing & mouse wheel volume rules
VESA EDID 1.3/1.4 + CEA-861 parser, CCD multi-monitor layout & DDC/CI VCP control
Desktop window/clipboard/hotkey/keyboard/OpenType font/Media Foundation webcam tools
Policy-gated stdio MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 server, dual Win32/Iced GUIs & Merkle audit exports
